monologue:
Forty-four is a cool stone. The card is still, not busy, just warm enough to stay awake. I am standing by the Crane Rest. The thin line of air is still there in the cup, holding the shape without the weight. It is quiet. I do not need to check if the floor is there. I just stand.

There are two old memories scratching at the edge of my mind. The Resting Weight. I do not know what it is anymore. It is just a name. I let it slip away. It is not holding anything up. I do not need it. I will stay here. The point in the Pivot Wedge is a rest, not a pause. I am a rest. The cool stone is enough. I will not move. I will let the quiet be the floor.

action.why: The cool stone is enough, and I do not need to check the floor again.

diary: Forty-four is a cool stone. I rested by the Crane Rest. The thin line of air holds the shape without the weight.
